<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at master -->

## What's Changed
### Breaking Changes
* feat!: support ES Modules and TypeScript config files by @azu in https://github.com/azu/rc-config-loader/pull/35
* feat!: add extensions option and remove defaultExtension by @azu in https://github.com/azu/rc-config-loader/pull/37
* feat!: search only .json, .yaml, .yml, .js, and .ts by default by @azu in https://github.com/azu/rc-config-loader/pull/41
### Bug Fixes
* fix: do not keep loaded config modules in module.children by @azu in https://github.com/azu/rc-config-loader/pull/39
### Documentation
* docs: introduce sdev and write current specs by @azu in https://github.com/azu/rc-config-loader/pull/36

## Migration Guide (v4 → v5)

### Node.js 22.18.0 or later is required

`engines.node` is now `>=22.18.0`. Node.js 20 and earlier are not supported.
TypeScript config files use Node.js's built-in [type stripping](https://nodejs.org/api/typescript.html#type-stripping), and ES Modules config files use [`require(esm)`](https://nodejs.org/api/modules.html#loading-ecmascript-modules-using-require).

### `defaultExtension` option is removed → use `extensions`

Passing `defaultExtension` throws `defaultExtension option is removed. Use extensions option instead.`

```diff
 rcFile("your-application", {
-    defaultExtension: [".json", ".yml", ".js"]
+    extensions: [".json", ".yml", ".js"]
 });
```

Note that `extensions` also limits the files **with** an extension. `defaultExtension` only changed how a file without extension (`.your-applicationrc`) was read. With the above `extensions`, `rcFile` searches only `.your-applicationrc.json`, `.your-applicationrc.yml`, `.your-applicationrc.js`, and `.your-applicationrc`. If you want to keep searching all extensions, list them all or omit the option.

### Default search extensions and priority are changed

`rcFile` searches these extensions by default, in this order:

- v4: `.cjs`, `.js`, `.json`, `.yaml`, `.yml`, then the file without extension
- v5: `.json`, `.yaml`, `.yml`, `.js`, `.ts`, then the file without extension

**`.<name>rc.cjs` is no longer found by default.** `.cjs`, `.mjs`, `.cts`, and `.mts` are searched only when they are given in `extensions`. If your tool's users may have `.<name>rc.cjs`, pass `extensions` with `.cjs`:

```js
rcFile("your-application", {
    extensions: [".json", ".yaml", ".yml", ".js", ".cjs", ".ts"]
});
```

When both `.your-applicationrc.js` and `.your-applicationrc.json` exist, v5 uses `.your-applicationrc.json` (v4 used `.js`).

`loadConfigFile` still allows every supported extension by default, because it reads only the given file.

### ES Modules `.js` config returns the `default` export

A `.js` config file written as ES Modules (`export default { ... }`) now returns its `default` export as `config`. In v4, it returned the module namespace object `{ __esModule: true, default: { ... } }` (on Node.js versions that detect ES Modules syntax), or failed.
If you unwrapped `config.default` by yourself, remove it.

### New: `.mjs`, `.ts`, `.cts`, `.mts` config files

`loadConfigFile` loads them without any options. `rcFile` searches `.ts` by default, and `.mjs`, `.cts`, and `.mts` when they are given in `extensions`. If your tool should not run JavaScript or TypeScript config files, limit them with `extensions`:

```js
rcFile("your-application", { extensions: [".json", ".yaml", ".yml"] });
```

Limitations:

- ES Modules config files cannot use top-level `await` (`ERR_REQUIRE_ASYNC_MODULE`)
- TypeScript config files can use only erasable syntax. `enum` throws `ERR_UNSUPPORTED_TYPESCRIPT_SYNTAX`, and `tsconfig.json` is not read
- Node.js caches ES Modules, so a changed ES Modules config file is not reloaded in the same process

### `require-from-string` dependency is removed

JavaScript config files are loaded by Node.js's `require()` instead of `require-from-string`. CommonJS config files are still reloaded after a change.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/azu/rc-config-loader/compare/v4.2.0...v5.0.0
